title: 第1617章 主动权在我
slug: 顶级奸商无敌从贩卖军火开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

天使领域可是个钱袋子啊。

林风巴不得从他们手中套点东西出来。

现在全世界也就他们可以和自己过招了。

这不，机会来了。

天长老没想到林风竟然毫不避讳，直接说出口。

【咳咳，商老板，我还不知道秘密……怎么给价格？】

【你疯了啊？】林风翻了个白眼：【你都知道秘密了，我还给个屁的价格。】

【……】

天长老心中无奈，他们天使领域完全被动。

卖家时代，没办法。

【好，我们天使领域退出渡硬国。】

【嗯，然后呢？说价啊，你说这玩意干嘛？】

【这。。就是我们的条件啊……】

冥王第一个不爽：【我去。。你说什么呢？】

【就是啊，退出渡硬国干嘛？来啊，打啊，打一年！】

【哈哈，你们天使领域能扛住一年吗？】

林风看白痴一样看着天长老：【你也没什么诚意啊。】

【这……】

【这什么？我以为我和聪明人谈生意。】

林风满脸戏谑的看着天长老。

【我大商来渡硬国干什么，天使领域会不知道？不就是打消耗战，你和我说退出？】

明牌了，不装了。

不就是战争吗？大商要的就是战争，你拿这个考验干部？

天长老深吸一口气，他思索了一圈，除了钱，除了让天使领域大出血，好像也没什么能让商天子动心的。

他又看了一眼大商所有干部。

沉声说道：【商老板，既然你马上要到美丽国了，我们当面详谈如何？】

【没问题！】林风满脸无所谓：【我在海上，这大海你也知道，不是刮风就是下雨，晚个十几天都有可能，你且等着。】

天长老心中苦笑，太没主动权了，这样的情报，晚个十天半个月，价值就要跌很多。

不过他没有再废话，而是点头：【好，静候到来，那我就先告辞了。】

【别啊，等会。】

林风笑着说道：【蓬莱岛的事情放一边，我们来谈一谈渡硬国的事情呗。】

【既然商老板回来了，那我们就不给您添麻烦，这就走。】

【别走啊，走什么？天使集团不赚钱了？】

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The Angel Realm is a money bag.

Lin Feng was eager to get something out of their hands.

Now they are the only ones in the world who can compete with them.

No, the opportunity has come.

Elder Tian did not expect Lin Feng to say it directly without any hesitation.

[Ahem, Boss Shang, I don’t know the secret yet... How can I give you a price?】

【Are you crazy?] Lin Feng rolled his eyes: [You already know the secret, and I’ll give you a shitty price.】

【……】

Elder Tian felt helpless, and their angelic realm was completely passive.

In the age of sellers, there is no other way.

[Okay, our Angel Realm withdraws from Du Hard Country.】

[Well, what then?Talking about the price, what are you talking about?】

【this..This is our condition...]

Pluto was the first to be unhappy: [I’ll go..What did you say?】

[That’s right, why are you quitting Du Hard Country?Come on, fight, fight for a year!】

[Haha, can your angel field last for a year?】

Lin Feng looked at Elder Tian like an idiot: "You have no sincerity.】

【This...】

【What is this?I thought I was doing business with smart people.】

Lin Feng looked at Elder Tian with a playful expression.

[Why did I, the great merchant, come to cross the hard country? Will the Angel Realm know about it?Isn't this just a war of attrition? Are you telling me to quit?】

It’s clear, don’t pretend anymore.

Isn't it just war?What Dachang wants is war. Do you use this to test your cadres?

Elder Tian took a deep breath and thought for a while. Apart from money, apart from bleeding the Angel Realm, there seemed to be nothing that could tempt Emperor Shang.

He took another look at all the cadres of Dashang.

He said in a deep voice: [Boss Shang, since you are going to the beautiful country soon, how about we discuss it in detail in person?】

【no problem!】 Lin Feng had a nonchalant look on his face: 【I'm at the sea. You know this sea. It's either windy or rainy. It could be more than ten days late. Just wait.】

Elder Tian smiled bitterly in his heart. He had too little initiative. If such information was received ten days and a half later, its value would have dropped a lot.

But he didn't talk nonsense anymore, but nodded: [Okay, wait and see, then I'll take my leave first.】

[No, wait a minute.】

Lin Feng smiled and said: [Let’s put aside the Penglai Island matter, let’s talk about crossing the Hard Country.】

[Since Boss Shang is back, we won’t cause you any trouble and we’ll leave now.】

[Don't go, why are you going?Angel Group is no longer making money?】
